#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    int ans = 0;
    // Precompute all multiples of 25 up to 10^8-1
    std::vector<std::string> multiples;
    for (int i = 0; i < 100000000; i += 25) {
        multiples.push_back(std::to_string(i));
    }
    for (const std::string& test : multiples) {
        if (test.length() != s.length()) continue;
        bool works = true;
        char xDigit = -1;
        for (size_t j = 0; j < test.length(); ++j) {
            char sc = s[j];
            char tc = test[j];
            if (sc == 'X') {
                if (xDigit == -1) xDigit = tc;
                else if (tc != xDigit) { works = false; break; }
            } else if (sc != '_' && sc != tc) {
                works = false; break;
            }
        }
        if (works) ++ans;
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
